description: This Java class 'PaginationData' is a plain old Java object (POJO) that implements Serializable to encapsulate pagination information such as page size, current page, offset, total count, and total pages. It provides methods to navigate to next or previous pages and to retrieve pagination metrics.

classes.name: PaginationData
classes.description: Java class representing pagination details with methods to navigate pages and calculate pagination metrics.

methods.name: PaginationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing pageSize and currentPage, throws exception if pageSize is zero.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the size of each page (number of results per page).

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page number based on the offset.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the starting index (offset) for the current page.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns a new PaginationData object representing the next page.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns a new PaginationData object representing the previous page.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of results available.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total count of results.

methods.name: getTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages, based on total count and page size.
